item.description: I know. Things change. Such is life. Especially in a city. item.title: Redev Hopefuls Tour 2 Empty Schools
item.description: In two dark, vacant, and dilapidated former school buildings on the east and west sides of town, potential redevelopers stepped carefully by abandoned math equations scrawled on whiteboards, dusty textbooks left on forgotten desks, and lockers filled with outdated student projects. The post Redev Hopefuls Tour 2 Empty Schools appeared first on New Haven Independent.

item.title: 115 Tenants Remain At Complex Eyed For Teardown, Buildup
item.description: More than 100 renters -- including Sayed Hamdard, his wife, and their four kids -- will have to leave a 58-unit apartment complex on George Street later this year, as their nonprofit landlord moves forward with plans to demolish the structure before building a new 81-unit redevelopment in its stead. The post 115 Tenants Remain At Complex Eyed For Teardown, Buildup appeared first on New Haven Independent.

item.title: Teachers Ratify New 3-Year Contract
item.description: City teachers voted overwhelmingly Friday in support of ratifying a new three-year contract that includes a 13 percent pay raise — but that does not move them onto a state health insurance plan. The post Teachers Ratify New 3-Year Contract appeared first on New Haven Independent.
